stages.title: Brief and site
stages.what: Goal, size, height, access, site conditions
questions: What are we building, and what is it for?
How big and how high is it, and where?
Can a crane, gantry or ground robot reach the whole build?
What does success look like, and by when?

stages.title: Fabrication method
stages.what: Aerial AM or a ground method
questions: Does size, access, congestion or scaffolding justify drones?
What would a ground method cost and take instead?
Is the team willing to carry the extra risk of a new method?

stages.title: Geometry
questions: Does the form slice into horizontal layers?
Are walls thin enough, and overhangs supported?
Which parts are inclined, and how steep?

stages.title: Material and tests
stages.what: Mix trials: weight, flow, shape, curing
questions: Foam or cement, and which mix?
Does it hold shape under downwash and the next layers?
How long does it stay workable, and how fast does it set?
Does it fit the payload per trip?

stages.title: Role and tolerance
questions: Is it enclosure, formwork, insulation or repair?
What deviation is acceptable for this role?
Does it need reinforcement or code approval?

stages.title: Digital twin and toolpath
questions: Does every interim stage stand on the twin?
Which toolpath gives the fewest trips?
Where would we redesign, re-sequence or scaffold?

stages.title: Plan and budget
questions: How many layers and trips, and how long?
How many robots, and how many crew per shift?
What is the budget for material, robots and crew?
Which permits and airspace approvals do we need?
What is frozen now, and what can still change?

stages.title: Site setup
stages.what: Positioning, refill station, safety zone, weather
questions: How do robots know where they are on this site?
Where is the refill and battery station?
Where is the safety zone, and who guards it?
How do we measure wind and temperature?

stages.title: Dry run
stages.what: Light-trace flight of the path, no material
questions: Do the robots follow the path within tolerance?
Do they keep safe spacing at the tightest layer?
Is the team ready to start printing?

stages.title: Load
stages.what: Material and battery onto the drone
questions: Is the mix still within its open time?
Is the battery enough for this layer?

stages.title: Deposit
questions: Is the robot tracking the path?
Is the flow matching the flight speed?

stages.title: Scan
stages.what: Camera drone maps the new layer
questions: Is the scan complete, with no gaps?

stages.title: Evaluate
questions: Is the layer within tolerance?
Has the layer below cured enough?
Does the next stage stay stable?
Are wind and temperature within limits?

stages.title: Adapt
stages.what: Offset the next path or redesign
questions: Can an offset fix the drift?
Is the drift large enough to redesign upper layers?
Has the change been logged as a new version?

stages.title: Layer gate
questions: Go, hold or adjust for the next layer?
If a robot failed: reassign or stop at this layer?
Who decided, and on what evidence?

stages.title: Final validation
questions: Does the as-built match the design within tolerance?
Accept, accept with notes, or remediate?

stages.title: Handover
questions: What did we learn about limits, mixes and weather?
What goes into the next project's defaults?
Is every decision traceable to its evidence?
